svg.title: Amortized Rotation Cost
svg.desc: Focused harness · macOS Intel · double · CPU-time · one orientation per batch; 30 repetitions per batch · shading: p10–p90 of repetition means · conversion included inside every cached batch. First measured break-even is host/workload dependent; not an API rule or WCET.
